ingested_at.basis: Committer time of the only commit that added these exact corpus bytes to this repository (PR #1). It is an upper bound on when the projection was built, not an upstream ingestion observation, so as a freshness input it can only overstate freshness. Using it in place of a controller-recorded ingestion time is not ratified and requires an owner decision. The commit signature was not verified.

license_basis: No per-row rights are declared. The repository Apache-2.0 licence is not a per-row rights adjudication, and the ingest lane summarises third-party projects. Unknown rights are refused by the gate. Only the owner may add declarations, each with its own basis.
